name: Ascari A10 "10th Anniversary"
description: The Ascari A10 is an ultra-exclusive supercar built by British manufacturer Ascari Cars to celebrate the company's 10th anniversary in 2006. Based on the KZ1, the A10 features a BMW-sourced 5.0-liter V8 engine that has been extensively modified to produce 625 hp and 680 Nm of torque. The lightweight carbon fiber and aluminum construction results in a curb weight of just 1,280 kg, enabling exceptional performance with a top speed exceeding 350 km/h. The mid-engine, rear-wheel-drive layout combined with a sequential gearbox delivers precise handling characteristics suited for both road and track use. Named after Alberto Ascari, the legendary two-time Formula 1 World Champion, the A10 was produced in extremely limited numbers, making it one of the rarest and most exclusive supercars of its era.
author: EX Mods
